# PoC 2 cable schedule (generated by blueprint.py)

PoC 2 (TENTATIVE 'robust'): 7-node TG bowtie, 3 IP-50 rungs, 2 coupling arms, DPIR only. 227 cables.

Nodes are managed in-band (E2E controller over the radio network); no node ETH2 or IP-50 management port is cabled. Lengths come from the digital twin's routes (twin/twin_model.py): IF and IP-50 SMA cables are the shortest stock length covering the bundle's longest route + 5 %, every other cable the shortest ladder length covering its route + 10 %; DC and earth cables are cut to the route + 10 %. Confirm at a dry fit.
